title: Money
description: Integer minor units. NEVER floating point. `0.1 + 0.2` is not `0.3` in IEEE 754 and currency arithmetic is mostly addition, so a total summed from float line items stops matching the sum of what is displayed. The exponent is not always 2: JPY and KRW have none, BHD/KWD/TND have three — so only formatting divides.
